analysis.summary: Abstract red smoke or flame visualization rising from glowing embers against black. The formation evolves from a wide mushroom shape to a tall elegant column with curling wisps. Deep crimson and bright orange-red tones create dramatic contrast.

frames.text: Vivid red smoke billows upward from glowing embers at the bottom of the frame against a black background. The smoke spreads wide at the top creating an organic mushroom shape. Bright orange-red core transitions to deep crimson at the edges with wispy tendrils.

A towering column of red smoke rises from embers, more vertically structured than the start. The central column glows bright red-orange while the edges fade to darker crimson. Curling wisps spiral outward creating an elegant flowing form.

Red smoke formation stretches vertically with a narrow waist and expanding top. The bright core illuminates from below by glowing coals. Symmetrical curling wisps on both sides create a flame-like silhouette against pure black.
